description: Join Megan Coy and Courtney Scheff as we canvass Berea at the Berea Branch ( 7 Berea Commons, Berea, Ohio 44017 ) at 10:00 am on October 17th. Even if you have no experience canvassing, all are welcome! Our team will help train you to door knock in this extremely pivotal race in Cuyahoga County.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Megan Coy
title: Berea Canvass with Megan Coy and Courtney Scheff — Megan Coy
